rules.training: sealed 720-MDP meta panel (R.meta_training order); opened test panels are never fitted
rules.metric: MDP-averaged integrated Brier (6 thresholds) and seven-class log loss (floor 1e-12)

m6.rule: adopt the simple head with the best external score if its internal relative IBS and LL are both <= +1% and its external score <= +1%; otherwise keep the ensemble

q_robust: finite-only head on the B2+legacy fields
m1.lambda: lambda_max * min(1, d / d0), or lambda_max if d0 = const

m4.rule: p'' = (1 - eps(d)) p' + eps(d) pi_learner, eps(d) = eps_max * min(1, d / d0)
m4.pi_learner: class distribution of the learner on meta primary rows

rules.d: mean distance to the 10 nearest meta-training primary rows in standardized B2 statistics, per MDP-behavior group
rules.d0_shared: one d0 for M1 and M4
rules.objective: external score = mean over the three external panels of (rel IBS + rel LL) / 2, lower is better
rules.constraint: internal (cohort 7 and 8 pooled over MDPs) rel IBS <= +0.02 and rel LL <= +0.02
rules.parsimony: among candidates within 0.002 of the best external score, take the smallest (lambda_max, eps_max) and prefer d0 = const, then larger d0
rules.lopo: for each external panel: select on the other two external panels under the same constraint, report the held-out panel
rules.success_check: point estimate vs B2+legacy on every external panel, both metrics (descriptive here; the gate is the final test)
